properties.description: Pre-reaction complex of diazomethane (C1=N2=N3) and ethylene (C4=C5) approaching for the 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition.
properties.energy_reference: sum of the two independently optimised components (no whole-complex minimum exists at PM7)
properties.component_evidence: PM7 optimisation+frequencies of the complex itself converge only to a very flat, unbound van der Waals contact: calc/rc_optfreq.log and calc/rc2_optfreq.log hit the 78/100-cycle limit, the 'loose' optimisation of the IRC outer frame (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0007/reactant_opt/reactant_opt.log + .../reactant_frequency/reactant_frequency.log) ends on a structure with a single -1.9 cm-1 numerical mode, so the species is annotated per component: diazomethane (calc/dzm_optfreq.log, 9 real modes) and ethylene (calc/ethene_optfreq.log, 12 real modes).

properties.description: Concerted, suprafacial 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition saddle point; the single imaginary mode (-679.4 cm-1) is the C1-C4 / N3-C5 forming motion.
1-Pyrazoline (4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole): the cyclic azo primary cycloadduct, a genuine minimum at PM7 (27 real modes).

Cheletropic N2 extrusion saddle point. Not accessible with trustworthy accuracy at PM7: the PM7 PES makes the extrusion endothermic by +13.8 kcal/mol, a synchronous constrained relaxation at C1-N2 = C5-N3 = 2.00 A already lies +63.8 kcal/mol above 1-pyrazoline, and the only stationary point the TS optimiser finds on the product side (C1-N2 = 3.72 A, C5-N3 = 3.69 A) has a numerically meaningless -4.1 cm-1 imaginary mode. Exploratory numbers only; no barrier is claimed.
Cyclopropane + N2. Not bound as a complex at PM7 (the only stationary point found for the dot-joined species carries a -19 cm-1 H-libration mode), so the species is annotated per component.
properties.energy_reference: sum of the two independently optimised products
properties.complex_evidence_log: calc/pc_optfreq.log (stationary point with 1 small imaginary mode, not a minimum)

properties.barrier_definition: E(TS1) - E(RC) = 0.1449855 - 0.1112662 Ha; RC energy is the sum of the two verified component minima because no whole-complex minimum exists at PM7
properties.note: C1=N2 and N2=N3 both lose bond order (2 -> 1) and C1-C4 / N3-C5 form, giving the 1-pyrazoline ring.

No barrier declared: the PM7 saddle for this step is not trustworthy (see TS2). Exploratory completed-path values: 1-pyrazoline -> cyclopropane + N2 is +13.8 kcal/mol endothermic at PM7 and no converged, physically meaningful saddle was found.
